source: Pattern library adapted from BC standardized housing designs, the NSW Housing Pattern Book and the GdW serial-construction framework (see docs/international-practices.md). Sized for a 25 x 125 Chicago lot (3,125 sq ft).
status: draft: sizes from spec defaults; cost per sq ft and plan sets come from the partner contractor and partner architects
use: Feasibility scenarios pick a pattern. The engine checks the pattern against the parcel's zoning path (units, FAR, height) and code thresholds, then prices it. Users can still enter a custom program.
